review_comments.body:
Test cases for whitespace seem relevant here given the "run of same-class" description. Using `|` as the cursor:

- `hello wor|ld` → `hello |ld`
- `hello world   |` → `hello |`
- `hello |world` → `|world`
I'm not familiar with the test harness API, but wouldn't the test hang at `.wait_gone("dropme")` if it failed?

comments.body:
Thanks, added the three whitespace cases as unit tests (`hello wor|ld`, `hello world   |`, `hello |world`).

On the e2e scenario: `wait_gone` has a timeout (`E2E_TIMEOUT`, 10 s by default) and fails the scenario with the screen contents when it expires, so a regression would fail rather than hang.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
